}

# Country scope. Combined fleet readiness score (0..100).
oe_ely_fleet_readiness = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_ely_fleet_morale }
		add = var:oe_ely_fleet_morale
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_ely_provisions }
		add = var:oe_ely_provisions
	}
	divide = 2
	floor = yes
}
